title: Robust Optimization for Green Ammonia Production
summary: The central challenge in optimizing green ammonia systems is satisfying the minimum-load requirements of the Haber-Bosch (HB) process under renewable uncertainty. We develop a robust optimization framework consisting of a strategic capacity planning model and an operational flow model under solar and wind uncertainty. The strategic model is a mixed-integer optimization (MIO) problem with flexible HB operating modes, namely hot-idling and shutdowns.
